title: 第13章 竹箫第14章 走了
slug: 修仙所有人都以为她背景很强
lines: 陈沫评价着，心中有些可惜，要是竹箫没有认巫未央为主，他倒是有点想用它来炼器，鬼邪惧怕这个品质，还真不是寻常材料能有的。
陈沫是个炼器师，崔景的炼器就是他教导的，对材料的各类属性了解的很。
巫未央从陈沫手中接回竹箫，心中有些欣喜，竹箫竟然认她为主了吗？
她又向陈沫讨教了一下认主之事。
“认主方式有两种，一是滴血认主，二是灵契认主。”
陈沫告诉她，“第一种看似简单，但必须认主对象心甘情愿选中了滴血之人，所以滴血认主必须得是对着有灵之物才行，第二种只要施展灵契之人实力强于认主对象或者能镇压认主对象即可。”
巫未央听完，又问道，“竹箫是有灵之物？”
陈沫摸摸胡子，“有灵之物实际上范围很广，有灵气，有灵魂，都可称为有灵之物，你这支竹箫灵气不浅，自然也是有灵之物。”
“是个好东西，好好珍惜吧。”
巫未央怎么会不珍惜呢，竹箫可是将她从尸山深谷里救了出来。
陈沫看向一旁的唐落天，“你们准备得怎么样了？”
“还有五天就得启程去九洲城了。”
唐落天：“弟子倒是准备得差不多了，只是今日周宣发难，柳师妹损失了许多清灵蔓，她有点忧心。”
柳苗苗的清灵蔓是三阶灵植，是她最好的灵植了，现在被周宣消耗了大半，她很担心在青簪会上没能走远。
炼气修士体内灵气不足，通常都是利用外物来施法，没了种子，柳苗苗的攻击手段就弱了许多。
陈沫皱眉，摸了摸左手大拇指的戒指，拿出了几颗干枯的种子。
“这是四阶荆棘蔓的种子，只是已经干枯许久，需得种下用水灵力和木灵力不断供养，才有可能恢复生机。”
唐落天凛然，郑重接过种子，准备今晚就给师妹种下。
是夜，月明星稀，朝天宗山顶上，绿影婆娑中，六道身影围成一圈，皆是神情肃穆地看着中央凸起的小土包。
唐落天抱胸抬手托下巴，“蕴养种子这件事情，我没做过，怎么做来着。”
其余人也跟着托下巴，叶葵说道，“柳师姐说说看。”
柳苗苗托着下巴，“如此干枯的种子，我倒是未曾试过，我平常的种子都是生机勃勃的，只需要一些木灵力即可催生。”
巫未央举手，“掌门说不仅要木灵力还要水灵力。”
叶葵看了一圈，“咱们有水灵力的，也只有唐师兄和我，以及小师妹吧。”
“我和小师妹大可忽略不计，那就只有唐师兄了。”
叶葵自动将自己和巫未央省略掉，练气四层和练气三层的灵力，那跟没有有什么区别。
唐落天嘴角抽了抽，“蚊子再小也是肉，不许偷懒。”
当然他说的是叶葵，他知道巫未央定然不会偷懒。
“小师妹你突破炼气三层正好，能将灵气转化成灵力使用了。”
他细细说了一番，巫未央认真听讲。
叶葵跟赵天辰说悄悄话，“唐师兄说话啰嗦，也只有小师妹什么都认真听了。”
赵天辰拍了拍她的头，“是你太懒，小师妹进宗门才半年就快追上我们修为了，你害臊不？”
content_en:
Chen Mo commented, with some pity in his heart. If the bamboo flute had not recognized Wu Weiyang as its master, he would have wanted to use it to refine weapons. Guixie was afraid of this quality, which was really not something ordinary materials could possess.
Chen Mo is a weapon refiner, Cui Jing's weapon refiner was taught by him, and he knows a lot about the various properties of materials.
Wu Weiyang took the bamboo flute back from Chen Mo and felt a little happy. Did the bamboo flute recognize her as its master?
She asked Chen Mo again for advice on recognizing the master.
"There are two ways to recognize the Lord, one is to recognize the Lord with a drop of blood, and the other is to recognize the Lord through a spiritual contract."
Chen Mo told her, "The first one seems simple, but the target must be willing to choose the one who sheds blood, so the one who sheds blood must be facing a spiritual thing. The second one only needs to be stronger than the target or can suppress the target."
After Wu Weiyang heard this, he asked again, "Is the bamboo flute a spiritual thing?"
Chen Mo stroked his beard and said, "Spiritual things are actually very broad. They have aura and a soul. They can all be called spiritual things. This bamboo flute of yours has a lot of aura, so it is naturally a spiritual thing."
"It's a good thing, cherish it."
How could Wu Weiyang not cherish her? Zhuxiao rescued her from the deep valley of the mountain of corpses.
Chen Mo looked at Tang Luotian aside, "How are you preparing?"
"We have to leave for Jiuzhou City in five days."
Tang Luotian: "Disciple is almost ready, but today Zhou Xuan launched an attack and Junior Sister Liu lost a lot of Qingling Man, so she is a little worried."
Liu Miaomiao's Qingling Man is a third-level spiritual plant, which is her best spiritual plant. Now most of it has been consumed by Zhou Xuan. She is worried that she will not be able to go far in the Green Hairpin Conference.
Qi refining monks lack spiritual energy in their bodies, so they usually use external objects to cast spells. Without the seeds, Liu Miaomiao's attack methods are much weaker.
Chen Mo frowned, touched the ring on his left thumb, and took out a few dried seeds.
"This is the seed of the fourth-level thorn vine, but it has dried up for a long time. It needs to be planted with water spiritual power and wood spiritual power to continuously support it, so that it can be restored to life."
Tang Luotian looked awe-inspiring and solemnly took the seeds, preparing to plant them for his junior sister tonight.
It was night, with a thin moon and stars. On the top of Chaotianzong Mountain, among the whirling green shadows, six figures formed a circle, all looking solemnly at the small bump in the center.
Tang Luotian crossed his chest and raised his hand to rest his chin, "I have never done this matter of cultivating seeds. How can I do it?"
The others also lifted their chins, and Ye Kui said, "Senior Sister Liu, tell me."
Liu Miaomiao held her chin, "I have never tried such dry seeds. My usual seeds are full of vitality and only require some wood spiritual power to germinate."
Wu Weiyang raised his hand, "The leader said that not only wood spiritual power but also water spiritual power is needed."
Ye Kui looked around and said, "The only ones with water spiritual power are Senior Brother Tang, me, and Junior Sister."
"Junior sister and I can be ignored, then only senior brother Tang is the one."
Ye Kui automatically omitted himself and Wu Weiyang. There was no difference between the fourth level of Qi training and the third level of Qi training.
The corner of Tang Luotian's mouth twitched, "No matter how small a mosquito is, it's still meat. Don't be lazy."
Of course he was talking about Ye Kui, and he knew that Wu Weiyang would definitely not be lazy.
"Little junior sister, you have just broken through to the third level of Qi refining, and can convert spiritual energy into spiritual power for use."
He spoke in detail, and Wu Weiyang listened carefully.
Ye Kui whispered to Zhao Tianchen, "Senior Brother Tang is very long-winded, but only Junior Sister listened carefully to everything."
Zhao Tianchen patted her head and said, "You are too lazy. It has only been half a year since Junior Sister entered the sect and you have almost caught up with us in cultivation. Are you ashamed?"
